teaser: The smell of gravel dust and cold engine oil in a trailhead parking lot, the tick of metal cooling after a long drive — that is as good a place as any to meet a life path 7 who is also an ISTP. The 7 wants solitude long enough to take a question down to its bones. The ISTP wants the question in hand, not in theory. Put them in one person and the search for truth gets carried out with tools instead of talk — a weekend spent taking something apart to understand it, rather than a weekend spent discussing it over coffee. The quiet here is not empty. It is occupied.
excerpt: Three leashes tangled around the same bench leg at the dog park, and a question asked mid-walk that doesn't get answered until the loop is nearly finished — that delay is not avoidance so much as how the answer gets…
